name: Pierce Camp Birchmont
description_short: A traditional co-ed overnight camp for boys and girls aged 7 to 15 on a 300-acre campus in Wolfeboro, New Hampshire. It offers 7-, 4- and 3-week sessions with over 30 activities in aquatics, athletics, arts and adventure.
